extra_checks: Clean water run through the boom first

Showers cleared and the leaf is dry

products.why: The label says Companion goes in first, before anything else. There's no copper in this tank, so its copper restraint is clear.
Acidic (pH 2–3). Goes in once the Companion is through the tank. You're at {before} L.

ppe_note: Companion damages eyes and GreenMaxx is a strong acid: face shield or goggles, elbow gloves and apron when you pour. Eyewash on the rig.
spray_rules: Greens mown, clippings and debris cleared. Dry leaf only: wait until the showers have cleared (forecast to about midday)

Spray when Delta T is 2 to 8 and wind is under 15 km/h. Gusts are forecast 30–35 km/h through the afternoon and easing from about 7pm: check the 6th green station first and stop if it's blowing off target
Foliar pass: do NOT water in. No irrigation or hand watering on these greens for 24 h
Men's Stableford is off the 1st until about 3:15pm. Never spray a green with golfers on or near it, and keep people off each green until it's dry
spray_more: GreenMaxx SDS: stir the IBC before drawing (it can settle), and keep it away from strong bases. Companion label: don't use with copper products.
post_checks: Irrigation off on the sprayed greens for 24 h and nobody hand watering them
Foliar pass: it has to stay on the leaf

flags.t: Wind and showers: the window is late afternoon or evening
flags.d: Open-Meteo at 9:45am: 14 km/h gusting 30, light showers (0.2 mm/h, 55–60%) until about midday, then dry. Gusts 31–35 km/h from 10am to 4pm, 28 at 5pm, 22 at 7pm, 14 at 8pm. Delta T 2.5–4 all day. This morning's Turf Watch called it no-go until 7:30–9pm; the dawn brief's WeatherCockpit read had gusts topping out at 20. On 26 Oct the 6th station read much lighter than the model, so check it at the shed before deciding.

flags.t: Grey nozzle maths: check the boom spacing
flags.d: Grey is ISO size 06: about 2.3 L/min at 2.8 bar. At 6.4 km/h that's about 430 L/ha on 50 cm nozzle spacing, or about 290 L/ha on 75 cm. On 50 cm spacing, holding 300 L/ha would take the pressure down to about 1.4 bar, below most air-induction tips' range (Red, size 04, at about 2.8 bar fits). With a fixed 100 L mix, 430 L/ha covers about 0.23 ha, not 0.33. The bucket test is on the rig checklist.
flags.s: ISO 10625 nozzle colour code · L/ha = 600 × L/min ÷ (km/h × spacing m)

flags.d: The sheet is named Fert + PGR to Greens but only lists Companion and GreenMaxx. This morning's Turf Watch has greens trinexapac at 112/200 GDD, due about 3 Nov.
GreenMaxx at 35 L/ha is about 9 kg N/ha (SG 1.31, 20% w/w) as stabilised urea, plus 1% Mg and 6% Fe. If its 20% is w/v, it's 7 kg N/ha.
